summary: Blast radius / spec fidelity: only export has --input among the four paged commands (query, finding list, divergence list reject --input as an unknown option, so F5's FLAG_ONLY_KEY is reachable on export alone; the document-key rule is enforced for them through the shared flags_only set and the schema check). Test 12 pins a 0.34 cursor as a literal made by the pre-change binary, which is sound only while the crate's decoder rejects it; I replayed a hand-made 0.34-shaped hex cursor and it is FOREIGN. CANON_ROLE is bound through a hand-written read in paging::given_of (role.rs ENV) because --as is not a clap env, so a future option with an env needs no change but another non-clap env source would be missed; the brief names CANON_ROLE as the only one. Not a defect.
